title: CoCoA: Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.29492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often favor Western-associated entities across cultural contexts. Conventional debiasing methods aim for uniform neutrality, but cultural bias mitigation demands context-conditional behavior, preferring culturally appropriate entities when cultural cues are present and remaining neutral when they are absent. We propose CoCoA (Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment), a framework that learns this behavior through dual-context training on the same entity pairs under contexts with and without cultural cues. CoCoA combines a contrastive alignment objective with calibration and drift regularization, optimized through goal-aware gradient reconciliation. We evaluate CoCoA on CAMeL and Camellia, two entity-centric cultural bias benchmarks, across ten language settings and four LLMs. CoCoA reduces the Cultural Bias Score from 43 to 24 on average while maintaining near-neutral preferences at 50.2, with minimal impact on

translated_title: CoCoA：面向大语言模型的情境条件化文化对齐
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在各种文化语境中往往偏爱与西方相关的实体。传统的去偏方法追求统一的中立性，但文化偏见的缓解需要情境条件化的行为：当存在文化线索时偏好文化上恰当的实体，当不存在文化线索时保持中立。我们提出了CoCoA（情境条件化文化对齐），一个通过在包含与不包含文化线索的双重情境下对相同实体对进行训练来学习这种行为的框架。CoCoA将对比对齐目标与校准及漂移正则化相结合，并通过目标感知的梯度调和进行优化。我们在CAMeL和Camellia这两个以实体为中心的文化偏见基准上，跨十种语言设置和四个大语言模型对CoCoA进行了评估。CoCoA将文化偏见得分平均从43降低到24，同时保持50.2的接近中立的偏好，对（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: CoCoA通过双重情境训练与目标感知梯度调和，使大语言模型在有文化线索时偏好文化上恰当的实体、无文化线索时保持中立，将文化偏见得分平均从43降至24。
en_tdlr: CoCoA is a context-conditional cultural alignment framework that trains LLMs to prefer culturally appropriate entities when cultural cues are present and remain neutral when absent, reducing the Cultural Bias Score from 43 to 24 on average across ten language settings and four LLMs.
